thread:
jess: Heads-up: onboarding quickstart README has a few copy/paste traps. Found two issues in a quick run-through from a new user: the curl example uses `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API` while our SDK snippets expect `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, and the Node example imports incorrectly which breaks for people copying the example.
jess: curl in README currently:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API\" \n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}]}'
```

jess: Python snippet elsewhere is using `os.environ.get('REDWOOD_API_KEY')`. New users paste the curl example, then try the Python/Node examples and get auth errors.

sam: Good catch. We should standardize to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` everywhere (and show an `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=\"...\"` example). I'll prepare a tiny PR to unify the env var name and tweak the curl header.

sam: Also the Node quickstart does `import Redwood from 'redwood'` which is wrong. Our public API is `RedwoodClient` as a named export. That one breaks in both ESM and CJS copy/paste cases.

alex: For Node/TS best practice let's show both ESM and CommonJS snippets, something like:
```js
// ESM
import { RedwoodClient } from 'redwood'
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })

// CommonJS
const { RedwoodClient } = require('redwood')
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
```

maria: I'll add a tiny docs CI check that scans quickstart and guides for the string `REDWOOD_API_KEY` so future edits don't accidentally introduce a different env var. Also adding an explicit one-liner above the snippets that says: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=\"<your-token>\"` (or set in your OS env manager).

jess: Can we also make the curl example more copy-paste friendly? Suggest using `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY\"` and avoid embedding newlines in the example so people who copy from GitHub don't miss a backslash.

sam: Agreed. I'll change the curl block to a single-line example and include the multi-line variant with backslashes for readability. Updating PR now.

maria: Pushed changes to the PR branch. I also fixed several fenced block language tags (```bash, ```py, ```js) so our snippet linter picks them up. cc @docs-bot for lint.

sam: I'll follow up by adding a short note to the onboarding email sequence so new signups know to export their env var before they copy/paste examples.
